question: Does the frozen relocated port detect unseen zero-frequency crossings?

port_config.port_variables: every bus-voltage coordinate z = (vx, vy) of the network, interleaved real form; the port is the Schur complement of the full DAE Jacobian onto z

derivation_from_the_dae.symmetry: R = (R_x, R_z): R_x = 1 on every delta and theta_pll, R_z = jV; f_x R_x + f_z R_z = 0 and g_x R_x + g_z R_z = 0 (rigid rotation invariance of the phasor DAE)
derivation_from_the_dae.partner: w: machine speed +1, PLL integrator +omega_B, synthetic-inertia filter +1, 68-bus speed-input PSS washout +K; A w = omega_B R_x whenever every machine has D = 0 and no governor (common-frequency drift)
derivation_from_the_dae.center_subspace: C = span{R_x, w}, exactly A-invariant, Jordan block [[0, omega_B], [0, 0]]
derivation_from_the_dae.reason: det T(s) inherits the structural double zero of det(sI - A) at s = 0, so the unrelocated port carries no information at the origin; moving exactly the two center eigenvalues away from 0 leaves every other eigenvalue unchanged (T1a and Brauer's rank-one theorem)

transformation.step_1: f_x# = f_x - beta * U U^T, U = R_x / ||R_x||
transformation.step_2: x0 = w + a R_x, a = omega_B / beta - (U^T w) / ||R_x||  (exact null vector of A#)
transformation.identity_checked: det T##(0) = det(g_z) det(-A##) / det(-f_x##), A## = f_x## - f_z g_z^-1 g_x
transformation.applicability: only when the partner w exists and is verified (A w = omega_B R_x within 10 eps)

port_config.detection_rule: A real (aperiodic) transverse eigenvalue crossing between two parameter points p_lo, p_hi on the same line is DETECTED iff sign det T##(0) differs between p_lo and p_hi, sign det(-f_x##) is equal at both points (no device-internal flip), and the verdict is the same for both beta pairs. Anything else is MISSED. A FALSE POSITIVE is a sign flip of det T##(0) between two points with no real transverse eigenvalue crossing between them.
port_config.ground_truth: The number of real positive eigenvalues of the transverse operator A_perp (quotient by C, theory/TRANSVERSE_STABILITY_QUOTIENT.md), computed from the eigenvalues, independent of the port. Crossings are bracketed on a fixed scan and bisected (40 iterations) on that count; the port is evaluated at the final bracket endpoints.

kundur.description: new operating/control slices never used to design the relocation (BC01 used the 194 G1 crossings of K12A (t = 1, k grid linspace(0.5, 2, 61)) and K12B (k = 1, t in [0.5, 1.375]))
kundur.oscillatory_negative_controls: complex-pair transverse crossings on the same lines, g in linspace(0.003, 1, 81), bisected; the port must NOT flip
kundur.no_crossing_negative_controls: consecutive scan points with identical transverse real and complex RHP counts; the port must NOT flip

holdout_design.ieee68: eligible only if a real transverse crossing exists; the frozen G3 map and the BC01 IEEE-68 audit contain none, so none is eligible
holdout_design.synthetic: random descriptor systems with an exact rotation, an exact Jordan partner and one parameterized real eigenvalue crossing 0 (FC02 synthetic test), 200 draws, seed 20260921

amendment_v1_1.date: 2026-09-10, after a one-line smoke test and BEFORE the full holdout run
amendment_v1_1.finding: Evaluating the port at the endpoints of a 40-step bisection places both points within ~1e-16 of the crossing, where the crossing eigenvalue is ~1e-11: below the resolution of ANY test, including the eigenvalue ground truth itself (smoke line t = 1.6, k = 1.15, subset 3+4: min |eig| of A## = 2e-11, determinant identity residual 4e-5). The rule as first written is undecidable by construction, independently of the port.
amendment_v1_1.change: The port and the ground truth are evaluated at the two FIXED scan points that bracket the crossing (real scan spacing 5e-5 in g; oscillatory scan spacing 0.0125). Bisection is kept only to report the crossing location g*. Nothing else changes (relocation, betas, detection rule, slices, controls). The smoke line stays in the holdout set.

port_config.no_result_dependent_changes_after: this file is committed before FC02 runs
